status: Local evidence/coordination contract; not repository policy
scope: Common vocabulary and evidence bookkeeping only. Each project owns all workflow, approval, model, concurrency, review, merge and production rules.
precedence: Follow applicable direct owner authority and the project's own precedence rules. Locate and reconcile the exact conflicting scope; never transfer another project's grant or apply a universal strictest-text rule.
findingRule: Use native dispositions. Late relevant findings must be assessed; workflow success is not a disposition. Duplicate/superseded findings point to their primary evidence. No C&C blocker whitelist, risk waiver, review cutoff or extra merge hold is created.
changeRule: Identify changed inputs and the checks that consume them. A receipt-only change needs accurate readback and any native receipt checks, not an automatic full audit. Candidate head/scope/material findings route to native policy; mandatory exact-head, independence and freshness conditions remain.
authorityRule: Verified applicable grants are reused without reapproval. A missing original is an authority-reconciliation gap, not proof the owner withheld permission. Preparation, risk acceptance, merge, hosted execution and publication remain separate.
partialEvidenceRule: An inbox window is scoped complete:false; no deletion inference outside it or full-baseline overwrite. Keep manual versus heartbeat provenance truthful.

metrics.unit: Identify artifact review versus accepted product delivery; do not mix denominators
metrics.comparison: Speed comparison requires matched work definitions, boundaries and quality/coverage. Cost savings requires comparable attributed costs including coordination/rework. ROI requires attributable benefit and full incremental cost, with uncertainty disclosed.
metrics.missing: Unknown is null with a reason, never inferred zero. Quotes, reservations, reported usage, estimated price and invoices remain separate.
metrics.speedFormula: (matched_baseline_elapsed - current_elapsed) / matched_baseline_elapsed; undefined without comparable baseline
metrics.savingsFormula: matched_baseline_attributed_cost - current_attributed_cost; undefined without comparable cost
metrics.roiFormula: (attributable_benefit - incremental_cost) / incremental_cost; undefined when inputs are missing or denominator is nonpositive
metrics.sampling: Capture existing delivery/review receipts once; no extra provider run, schedule, duplicate board or metrics-only PR.
metrics.reportTrigger: Retain the local 30-day or 10 accepted-product-delivery review target. While timer is paused, no scheduled collection occurs. Manual authorized outcomes can append evidence.

notAuthority: No executing agent, reviewer or merger is dispatched by this contract
No product readiness can be inferred from passing helper checks
No source/consumer adoption or money saving is inferred from these files
